summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of WhatsApp AI Auto-Reply Agent (EchoPilot). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests PASSED covering settings, import preview/confirm (valid + invalid), demo idempotency, contacts CRUD with delay validation (3-1800), messages send-as-contact/me, auto-reply LLM generation (Hinglish reply confirmed), cancel-pending, delete cascade, and reanalyze. Frontend UI: chats-screen loads, away-mode-switch toggles and persists, contact rows render, contact-profile-screen loads with style-profile-card populated, delay-chip-5 updates delay (badge now shows 5s), auto-reply-switch works, chat-screen loads, send-as-contact-toggle + message-input + send-message-button send messages, countdown-banner appears with cancel-auto-reply-button (I'm here) which cancels the countdown, typing-indicator shows, and AI Agent bubble with 'AI Agent · as Arjun' tag appears with authentic Hinglish reply (verified via screenshot: 'haan bhai kal to free hu kaun si movie soch raha hai tu'). import-fab navigates to /import screen; reanalyze-button + delete-contact-button present on profile. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). One minor console warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' from React Native Web.

issues: React Native Web console warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — FAB in index.tsx uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset. Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+/RNW compatibility.

action_items: (Optional/low-priority) Migrate shadow* style props on the FAB in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (styles.fab, ~lines 414-418) to the new boxShadow prop to silence RN Web deprecation warning. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: All endpoints correctly use /api prefix, exclude Mongo _id via projection, use async motor, HTTPException with meaningful details, Pydantic validation with Field(ge=3, le=1800) on delay. Delete cascades properly (contacts + chat_history + sim_messages). Good.
server.py:389: /demo idempotency correctly checks existing 'Rahul (Demo)' before creating.
server.py:495-537: /auto-reply flow — pending gate, LLM call with try/except, empty-reply guard, marks all pending replied atomically. Solid.
api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env correctly; JSON error detail surfaced to UI.
index.tsx: uses SafeAreaView insets, Switch, FlatList, RefreshControl — no HTML elements, all text wrapped in Text. Good.
No file exceeds 700 lines. Good separation.
seed_data_creation: The demo contact 'Rahul (Demo)' was created earlier and persisted. Tests are idempotent and reuse it. Test-created 'Priya/Sam' contact is deleted at end of confirm+cascade test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows validated. Demo contact 'Rahul (Demo)' persists in DB with auto_reply_delay_seconds now set to 5 (was 15) for faster UI testing. Backend LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.6) takes 5-20s per auto-reply — use timeout>=60s. Frontend countdown is client-side; countdown-banner then typing-indicator then AI Agent bubble sequence works as designed. Deprecation warning about shadow* style props is cosmetic only.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All features work as specified.
